llm.summary: The skill's requirements and instructions are internally consistent with a cloud-based multimodal AI SDK: it only needs python3 and a CELLCOG_API_KEY and its instructions show how to call the CellCog service and submit files for processing.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (Any→Any multimodal agent) align with what the SKILL.md describes. Requesting python3 and CELLCOG_API_KEY is expected for a Python SDK that talks to a cloud API.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The instructions explicitly instruct the agent to embed absolute file paths inside <SHOW_FILE> tags so files on the host will be processed by CellCog's cloud service. That is coherent with the skill's purpose, but it means local files will be uploaded to an external service — a privacy/exfiltration consideration the user should be aware of.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec or downloads are present; instructions suggest 'pip install cellcog' only if import fails. Instruction-only skills have low on-disk footprint.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only one environment variable (CELLCOG_API_KEY) is required, which matches the declared requires.env. No unrelated credentials or config paths are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Skill is not always-enabled and uses default model invocation settings. It does not request system-wide persistent presence or modify other skills/configuration.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill will send requests (and any referenced files) to CellCog's cloud service using the CELLCOG_API_KEY you provide. Before installing or using it: 1) only provide an API key with the minimum required privileges and consider using a test/ephemeral key for sensitive data; 2) do not include highly sensitive files (PII, secrets, private keys) in <SHOW_FILE> prompts unless you accept they will be uploaded to cellcog.ai; 3) review billing/credit implications (large multimodal tasks can be expensive) and the CellCog privacy/terms on the listed homepage; 4) verify the API key URL and homepage match the vendor you expect.
